description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage AI company building multimodal agents for customer conversations across voice, SMS, and email. You will own a core product or engineering domain end to end, working closely with customers and the team to shape the product and bring improvements into production.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own a product or infrastructure domain from architecture through daily production releases.

 - Speak with customers, synthesize feedback, and make product decisions without a dedicated product manager.

 - Build and optimize multimodal agents, including low-latency voice experiences and persistent conversation state across channels.

 - Set quality practices for non-deterministic systems, including evaluations, prompt versioning, guardrails, and drift detection.

 - Work across React and Next.js frontends, Node.js backends, and Python services.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Three to eight years of full-stack engineering experience, with a track record of shipping and scaling products from early development into broader use.

 - Production proficiency in TypeScript, Node.js, React, and Next.js, plus experience building Python services.

 - Hands-on experience shipping production systems with LLM APIs or agent SDKs.

 - Depth in at least one area: production voice or SMS agents, long-running agent state and memory, agent evaluations and guardrails, or B2B2C and marketplace products.

 - Experience making independent product decisions, conducting customer discovery, and owning projects through launch.

 - Strong AI or agentic systems experience, including work with low-latency requirements and unpredictable system behavior. Voice pipeline or evaluation tooling experience is useful.

 - Comfort working in an early-stage environment with changing priorities and limited process.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $180,000 to $250,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

On-site, five days per week in New York, New York.
